jobs.title: MS Senior Assessor
jobs.reason: This is a quality/safety/environment auditing role requiring a technical engineering degree, ISO 9001/14001/45001 qualifications, and qualified third-party auditor status — none of which the candidate holds. Field, skills, and credentialing are a complete mismatch with the candidate's IR/policy background.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor
jobs.reason: Social compliance auditing is outside the candidate's core targets (IR research, geopolitical risk, OSINT/policy), and the role requires specialised auditing expertise (APSCA/CSCA/ASCA certifications, supplier compliance assessment experience) plus mandatory Italian language proficiency, which the candidate does not have. Hard ineligibility on language requirement.

jobs.title: Auditor ISO 9001 und Lebensmittelindustrie
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a food-industry quality auditor role requiring a bachelor's in food technology/process engineering, 5+ years of food safety/quality management experience, and ISO 9001/BRCGS/IFS/FSSC 22000 auditor qualifications. Hard ineligibility on multiple counts: 5+ years' specialist experience required, plus specific technical qualifications the candidate does not hold.

jobs.title: MSC Chain Of Custody Auditor (Korea)
jobs.reason: This is a fisheries/food supply chain auditing role requiring specialist lead auditor certification (CQI/IRCA, EMS, QMS, HACCP) and 3–5 years of food industry experience — none of which the candidate has. The role is also based in Korea, requiring Korean language capability for fieldwork. Multiple hard mismatches across field, skills, and seniority.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor
jobs.reason: This is an automotive industry quality-systems auditor role requiring a mechanical/electronic engineering degree, IATF/IRCA qualifications, and 4+ years in the automotive industry — none of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility on both specialist technical qualifications and the 4+ years automotive experience requirement; also requires working French at C-level (candidate is B1).

jobs.title: Project Support Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is a project coordination role in nuclear and pressure equipment conformity assessment — an engineering/industrial assurance field with no overlap with the candidate's IR, policy, or intelligence targets. It also requires "a significant number of years" of project coordination experience and technical knowledge of UK nuclear/pressure equipment regulations, which the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Contractor on Demand (Lead auditor Automotive - IATF)
jobs.reason: This is a Lead Auditor role requiring IATF automotive industry qualification and senior auditing experience — a specialist vocational credential the candidate does not hold. Field, skills, and seniority all mismatch entirely with the candidate's IR research profile.

jobs.title: Assistant Program / Account Manager
jobs.reason: Role requires fluent Mandarin for client and supplier communication, which the candidate does not speak — hard ineligibility on language. Additionally, the role demands 5+ years of relevant supply-chain/ethical-sourcing experience and is focused on commercial account management rather than policy research.

jobs.title: Contractor on Demand (Lead auditor GFSI Food schemes)
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a food-industry lead auditor role requiring a food technology degree, 3+ years food sector experience, IFS/BRC auditing qualifications, and working Czech. Hard ineligibility on multiple grounds: specific vocational qualifications the candidate lacks, 3+ years food-industry experience, and Czech language requirement.

jobs.title: Contractor on Demand (Lead auditor ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001)
jobs.reason: This is a specialist ISO lead auditor contractor role requiring formal Lead Auditor qualifications in ISO 9001/14001/45001 — a vocational/professional certification the candidate does not hold. Field (quality/environmental/safety auditing) is entirely unrelated to IR, policy, or intelligence work.
